question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Glad
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Gloomy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Glad"** means feeling pleasure, joy, or happiness. (खुश)

 
 
• **Example:** She was glad to hear the good news about her promotion.
 
 
 
• **"Gloomy"** refers to feeling downcast, sad, or depressed. (उदास)
 
 
• **Example:** The gloomy weather made everyone feel lethargic and unmotivated.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'glad'** is **'gloomy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option (3) i.e. Gloomy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Cheery** (प्रसन्न): Full of cheerfulness and happiness.

 
 
• **Example:** Her cheery smile brightened everyone’s day.
 
 
 
• **Delighted** (प्रसन्नचित्त): Feeling or showing great pleasure.
 
 
• **Example:** They were delighted to meet their childhood friend after so many years.
 
 
 
• **Joyous** (आनंदमय): Feeling or causing great happiness and joy.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a joyous occasion as they celebrated their anniversary.
